name: Close to the Sun
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level druid 9, sorcerer/wizard 9

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, F (a magnifying glass)

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Targets one creature/level, no two of which are more than 60 ft. apart

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

You unleash deadly beams of sunlight from the magnifying glass. The target creatures are dealt 1d6 fire damage per caster level (maximum 25d6). Undead and plants are deals 1d8/level instead of 1d6, to a maximum of 25d8. Any creature that takes damage is fatigued. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and prevents from being fatigued. Undead are not immune to this Fortitude save but they may be immune to the fatigue.

This spell must be cast within sight of the sun.
